title.narrative: TB Platforms for Sustainable Detection, Care and Treatment (TB Platforms)

description.narrative: (Philippines): USAID, through the TB Platforms activity, will strengthen and sustain supportive interventions to increase case detection of TB and drug-resistant TB (DR-TB) and improve treatment success rates. It advances the U.S. government's Global TB Strategy, USAID's Global Accelerator to End TB, and the U.S. priority to defend the U.S. against the spread of deadly infectious diseases. .USAID will support local governments and communities to adapt and recover from the reduction in TB and DR-TB service provision due to COVID-19 by assisting the Department of Health National TB Control Program's Adaptive Plan to COVID-19 and the TB Recovery Plan. USAID will support health providers to adopt high-impact case-finding approaches, contact investigation, and the FAST ("finding cases actively, separating safely, treating effectively") Plus strategy. USAID will increase demand for TB services through social and behavior change activities that: reduce stigma; deploy facility-level quality improvement teams to roll out patient-centered interventions; integrate TB diagnosis and treatment as part of hospital-wide approaches to infection control and case finding; assist local government units (LGUs) to establish more responsive TB strategies in post-disaster environments; analyze local TB data to identify hotspot areas and risk groups; and support adoption and scale up of digital adherence tools to improve treatment compliance...USAID's COVID-19 mitigation interventions ensure continuity of TB services and include strengthening human resources for health at the LGU level to improve TB testing, expand community outreach, including contact investigation and the use of virtual platforms, set up TB contact centers, and integrate TB screening and detection in COVID-19 response..To support the integration of local health systems, USAID will help establish the Health Care Provider Network, the platform for integrated service delivery, in selected sites.
